props.text: A globe whose map streams in as you move it. Drag to turn the globe and scroll to zoom, from the whole planet down to a city's streets: at each zoom, the vector tiles the view shows load from VersaTiles (OpenStreetMap data, no key) and draw as they arrive, finer tiles over coarser ones. On top, every earthquake of magnitude 4.5 or more in 2024 (6,397, from the USGS catalog), sized by magnitude and colored by depth, traces the plate boundaries.
